subject.title: docs cat drops person smart chips from all output modes (plain, --plain, --json); readable only via --raw

question: Should `gog docs cat` accept the opt-in `--chips` flag plus additive `renderedText` and `chips` JSON fields proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/gogcli/pull/909 as the smart-chip readback contract?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but `docs cat` is a stable scripting surface and the fix changes visible output semantics or adds new output fields.

options.title: Accept opt-in/additive contract
options.body: Preserve existing default text while exposing chip rendering through an explicit flag and additive JSON fields, then close this issue when the linked PR lands with proof.

options.title: Render chips by default
options.body: Treat invisible chip omission as a stronger correctness bug and make existing text output include chip renderings, accepting the script-visible change intentionally.

options.title: Defer output shape
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause the linked PR until maintainers choose a different plain/JSON contract.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in/additive contract
recommendation.body: Preserve existing default text while exposing chip rendering through an explicit flag and additive JSON fields, then close this issue when the linked PR lands with proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected to the current Docs read extractor and merged smart-chip insertion surface in git history.
